title: Persistent line process
responsibility: Keeps a lazily started child process for sequential line exchanges and converts startup, exit and timeout failures to runtime responses.

inputs.name: lineProcess.command
inputs.description: Executable name or path passed to spawn from node:child_process without a shell, started by the first exchange and started again by any exchange after the previous child has stopped. A child 'error' event clears the child and resolves any pending exchange with a runtime-unavailable failure that names this command.

inputs.name: lineProcess.args
inputs.description: Argument array passed to spawn from node:child_process with piped standard streams, one element per argument and no shell parsing. The same array is reused each time the child is started again after it stops.

inputs.name: unavailable.command
inputs.description: Command name placed after 'cannot start ' in the runtime-unavailable message, and the value is not validated or trimmed. lineProcess passes its own command here.

inputs.name: unavailable.error
inputs.description: Startup error whose message property is appended after the command name and a colon in the runtime-unavailable message. No other property of the error is read, so its stack is not included.

inputs.name: exited.code
inputs.description: Exit status of the child, or null when no numeric status is known; null is written as unknown in the runtime-failed message. lineProcess passes the code from the child's close event.

inputs.name: exited.stderr
inputs.description: Error-output text that is trimmed and reduced to its last 200 UTF-16 code units, then appended after a colon only when that text is not empty. lineProcess always passes an empty string, so its exit failures carry no detail.

outputs.name: lineProcess
outputs.description: Handle with exchange(line, timeoutMs) and close(). exchange writes the line with each LF or CRLF line break replaced by a space and terminated with a newline, then resolves with the next stdout line or a failure; a timeout kills the child with SIGKILL before it resolves, while close kills the child with SIGKILL, clears the buffer, and leaves a pending exchange to end when its timeout fires.

outputs.name: unavailable
outputs.description: Runtime failure with code runtime-unavailable and message 'cannot start ' followed by the command, a colon, a space, and the startup error message. lineProcess returns it as the failure of any pending exchange, and the next exchange spawns the command again.

error.message: cannot start node: spawn node ENOENT
cannot start python3: spawn python3 EACCES

outputs.name: exited
outputs.description: Runtime failure with code runtime-failed and message 'process exited with code ' followed by the exit status (unknown for null), plus ': ' and the trimmed stderr detail, capped at its last 200 UTF-16 code units, only when that detail is not empty. lineProcess returns it as the failure of any pending exchange when the current child closes.

error.message: process exited with code 2: Error: unexpected token in input
